title: Neural Pixelate V4 our best model yet is out.
author: black-magik-studios
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/n68bjcr9zx0i1.gif

Last time we posted we were focused on making the move from aseprite to our own standalone application to improve the accessibility of our tool. In this release we're going back to improving the quality of our models.

The main focus on the model this time was optimizing the boundary between the your art and the background, aligning the art to a proper grid and reducing the amount of randomly shifted pixels.

https://i.redd.it/xsqg0ze8zx0i1.gif

https://i.redd.it/1lzf9dgczx0i1.gif

# Measuring the improvements

We've run V4 through the same expanded benchmark as before: 100 source images and 4,100 scored cases, measuring color accuracy, palette preservation, edge consistency, pixel placement and overall image fidelity.

V4 beats V3 on almost every metric we measure, sitting top in class for nearly every test in our benchmark.

Some of the most notable improvements:

|Metric|V3|V4|Improvement|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|
||
|||||
|Exact pixel match (higher is better)|67.28%|77.54%|**+15.2%**|
|Mean color error (lower is better)|2.735|1.851|**32.3% lower**|
|95th-percentile color error (lower is better)|10.980|7.073|**35.6% lower**|
|Palette violation rate (lower is better)|29.11%|20.03%|**31.2% lower**|
|Palette-size error (lower is better)|7.253|0.291|**96.0% lower**|
|PSNR (higher is better)|33.15 dB|41.50 dB|**+25.2%** (+8.35 dB)|

Compared with our original V1 model:

* Exact pixel matching has gone from 3.42% to 77.54%.
* Mean color error is down about 73%.
* Local palette violations are down about 78%.

https://i.redd.it/d1gpj8klzx0i1.png

https://i.redd.it/wotigi8mzx0i1.png

Thank you to everyone who has downloaded and left us comments we read through them all and use the feedback to improve our tools.

You can find the v4 release on our itch page here: [https://blackmagikstudios.itch.io/](https://blackmagikstudios.itch.io/)
